authority_note: Dated September 12 re-review supersedes prior current judgments; historical raw data and studies remain immutable.
portfolio_context: Actual holding, tax basis and portfolio risk budget were not supplied in this run. No position size is invented and buy authorization remains false.
structural_thesis: REJURAN's domestic clinical brand, PN/PDRN manufacturing know-how and physician channel are increasingly translating into a global regenerative-aesthetics platform. H1 2026 exports rose 47% and reached 44% of sales, while European medical-device rollout and U.S. cosmetics localization broaden the growth vector. The thesis still depends on proving that overseas sell-through, regulatory approvals and repeat procedure economics persist beyond initial channel buildout.
current_finding: Harness-rule TTM diagnostics are approximately KRW0.604T revenue, KRW0.238T operating income, KRW0.195T net income and KRW0.173T operating cash flow. TTM disclosed PPE purchases were about KRW0.035T, leaving mechanical OCF-minus-PPE of about KRW0.138T. This is not normalized owner FCF because H1 cash conversion weakened despite higher earnings, working capital, intangible/R&D cash investment, acquisitions and growth capex are not fully normalized.
economic_finding: H1 2026 revenue was KRW324.8B and operating profit KRW123.8B, with 38.1% operating margin; exports were KRW142.8B, up 47%, representing 44% of sales. Q2 exports reached KRW84.0B and 47% of quarterly sales. Medical-device export growth and cosmetics export growth support a broadening international demand base, but channel sell-through and country-level repeat usage remain more important than shipment growth alone.
capital_and_survival: June 2026 cash and cash equivalents were about KRW220.3B. Reported borrowings including bonds were KRW213.7B, but approximately KRW207.3B was redeemable convertible preferred-share liability; bank borrowings were only about KRW0.5B. The existing Base model treats the preferred claim as a redemption cash claim and does not simultaneously add conversion shares. Plant 5 and CG USA expand strategic capacity, but their realized incremental returns remain unproven.
permanent_loss_case: REJURAN growth slows after channel fill; competing PN/biostimulator products narrow pricing and physician preference; U.S. medical approval takes longer or requires a less favorable regulatory path; Plant 5 and CG USA absorb capital at low utilization; H1-style cash conversion weakness persists; RCPS converts or is redeemed on terms that reduce common-holder value; and a brand/regulatory shock hits a business still economically concentrated in the REJURAN ecosystem. The company can remain solvent while per-share owner cash and valuation compress for years.
falsifiers: Overseas shipment growth fails to convert into repeat sell-through, reorder growth and cash collection for at least two reporting periods.
Medical-device or cosmetics export growth slows materially while domestic REJURAN demand also weakens.
A material safety, regulatory or reimbursement issue impairs the REJURAN franchise in a major market.
Plant 5 or CG USA ramps with low utilization or after-tax returns below the 10% hurdle.
OCF per share persistently lags earnings growth after receivables, inventory and channel working capital normalize.
RCPS rights create materially worse common-share economics than the current redemption/conversion sensitivity range.
New PN/biostimulator competitors cause sustained price, procedure-share or physician-adoption erosion.
U.S. medical-device approval pathway becomes materially longer or more capital-intensive than current planning assumptions.
Management revisits a shareholder-unfriendly restructuring without stronger minority-shareholder protections.
Normalized owner margin falls structurally below the low-20s while growth also normalizes.
increase_evidence: At least two reporting periods showing overseas sell-through, reorder growth and OCF per share improving together.
Evidence that Plant 5 and CG USA generate after-tax incremental returns above the 10% hurdle after ramp.
REJURAN Europe expands across the contracted 22-country network with durable physician adoption rather than one-time distributor stocking.
U.S. cosmetics local manufacturing improves gross-to-cash economics and does not require value-destructive acquisition follow-ons.
The RCPS is redeemed, converted or otherwise resolved with clearly quantified common-share economics and no double counting of claim/dilution.
Product mix broadens beyond a single REJURAN franchise while medical-device and cosmetics margins remain strong.
Expectation gap remains favorable at a 10% required return; price decline alone is insufficient without the business evidence above.
sell_evidence: Two or more periods of deteriorating REJURAN sell-through, export reorder rates and OCF per share.
Material regulatory or safety impairment to REJURAN in Korea, Europe or another major market.
Plant 5/CG USA capital earns returns below the hurdle while management continues aggressive expansion.
Persistent receivable/inventory growth indicates distributor loading or weak end-demand conversion.
RCPS or other equity-linked financing causes material dilution without proportional owner-cash-per-share growth.
A renewed restructuring materially weakens minority-shareholder rights or creates an avoidable holding-company discount.
Competitive PN/biostimulator products cause sustained price or physician-share erosion.
Normalized owner margin and growth fall together such that the Base valuation no longer supports the thesis.

evidence: H1 2026 exports were KRW142.8B, up 47% YoY and 44% of consolidated sales; Q2 export share reached 47%.

REJURAN has a 22-country European distribution framework and 2026 rollout activity across Western Europe, while REJURAN Cosmetics is building U.S. retail/e-commerce and local manufacturing capability.
counter_evidence: International expansion is still early in several markets and U.S. medical REJURAN is not yet approved.

evidence: H1 operating margin remained 38.1% while revenue grew 26%, consistent with strong clinical/brand customer value rather than low-margin channel expansion.
The company operates recurring physician education and a broad REJURAN/REJUVIEL/biostimulator/toxin aesthetics portfolio.
counter_evidence: Aesthetic procedures are discretionary, physician preference can shift and cosmetics brand demand is more trend-sensitive.
missing_data: Independent procedure-level repeat-rate and physician retention data by country.

evidence: European distribution and physician programs indicate the REJURAN brand and PN clinical proposition are traveling beyond Korea.
DOT PN/PDRN manufacturing know-how, regulatory history and physician education create a differentiated adoption stack.
counter_evidence: The company claim that REJURAN is the only EU-MDR-approved PN medical device was not independently reconstructed, the original patent horizon creates a 2028 monitoring point, and the U.S. medical approval path remains uncertain.
Competing PN, PLLA and other biostimulator offerings can erode procedure share even if the category grows.
missing_data: Independent country-level share, pricing and physician-retention data.

evidence: TTM operating margin is about 39.4% and mechanical OCF-PPE is about KRW137.9B.
Strong demand has justified material capacity expansion and localization.
counter_evidence: H1 OCF fell about 13.8% YoY while net income rose about 34.5%, and H1 PPE purchases rose about 33%.
Plant 5 and CG USA are new capital cohorts whose post-ramp after-tax incremental ROIC is not yet observable.
missing_data: Post-ramp invested-capital and NOPAT cohorts; normalized working-capital and intangible/R&D cash investment.

evidence: 2025 payout increased to about 25% of consolidated net income and the company states an intention to maintain at least 25% payout from 2026.
The company cancelled treasury shares in 2025 and withdrew the proposed holding-company split after shareholder feedback.
CVC capital has been deployed toward international distribution and M&A/localization rather than balance-sheet repair.
counter_evidence: The 2025 split proposal raised legitimate minority-shareholder-value concerns before being withdrawn.
CG USA purchase terms are undisclosed and the large RCPS package creates continuing rights/dilution complexity.
missing_data: Realized acquisition returns and final RCPS resolution economics.

evidence: June cash and cash equivalents were about KRW220.3B and operating cash flow remained positive.
Most of the KRW213.7B reported borrowings/bonds amount is the KRW207.3B RCPS liability; bank borrowings were minimal.
counter_evidence: Plant 5, acquisitions and potential RCPS redemption can consume substantial cash simultaneously.

evidence: At KRW349,500, retained Base value of about KRW633,662 is roughly 81% above price.
Holding Base economics requires only about 4.53% annual revenue growth in years 2-10 at a 10% hurdle after a KRW0.78T year-1 revenue base.

counter_evidence: Retained Bear value is about 54% below price and a brand/regulatory shock can be nonlinear because the business remains concentrated in the REJURAN ecosystem.

evidence: The FY2025 audit report is published and no material accounting-integrity failure was identified in the reviewed filing evidence.
The withdrawn 2025 split proposal is treated as a governance/capital-allocation issue, not evidence of accounting misconduct.
items.resolution_needed: Reassess on audit, internal-control, related-party or disclosure deterioration.

evidence: The company remains profitable and cash generative; current operating survival does not require repeated external financing.
The 2024 CVC RCPS was strategic growth capital, but it remains a claim that must be modeled separately from operating funding dependence.
items.resolution_needed: Monitor if Plant 5/M&A spending materially outruns internal cash generation.

evidence: CVC's 1,175,647 RCPS carries conversion rights and represents about 11.3% of the current common-share denominator if converted one-for-one.
Base valuation treats the current preferred liability as a redemption claim; a conversion sensitivity removes that claim before adding shares, avoiding double counting.
items.resolution_needed: Resolve the RCPS path and quantify common-holder economics after conversion/redemption; do not count both cash redemption and conversion dilution simultaneously.

evidence: Revenue, operating profit and exports are all growing with high margins; no customer-financing or subsidy mechanism was identified.
H1 OCF weakness is material but not sufficient by itself to label reported growth low quality.
items.resolution_needed: Track receivables, inventory, distributor sell-through and OCF/share for at least two periods.

evidence: No collapse is proven, but Plant 5 and CG USA create large new capital cohorts while H1 cash conversion weakened.
Project-level after-tax incremental returns are not yet observable.
items.resolution_needed: Measure post-ramp utilization, incremental NOPAT, working capital and cash returns versus the 10% hurdle.

evidence: Export growth, European rollout and physician engagement do not show persistent moat contraction.
The moat remains subject to patent, competitive and U.S.-regulatory monitoring.
items.resolution_needed: Track pricing, procedure share, physician retention and competitor adoption.

evidence: At KRW349,500, retained Base economics require about 4.53% annual revenue growth in years 2-10 at a 10% hurdle, well below recent growth rates.
Current price is materially below retained Base value, so a Bull-only path is not required.
items.resolution_needed: Reopen if price rises materially without corresponding owner-cash evidence or Base assumptions deteriorate.

evidence: Geographic and category diversification is improving, but a large portion of economic value still depends on the REJURAN brand/PN ecosystem.
A product-safety, regulatory or physician-preference shock could affect both the medical-device franchise and associated cosmetics halo.
items.resolution_needed: Require clearer product-level revenue/profit diversification and evidence that non-REJURAN platforms can offset a flagship shock.

evidence: The balance sheet and current valuation discount reduce the probability of permanent capital impairment relative to the prior price.
Open RCPS, incremental-ROIC and flagship-concentration gates remain explicit and can reopen this veto if evidence worsens.
items.resolution_needed: Reassess immediately if sell-through, cash conversion, regulatory status or common-holder rights deteriorate.

attacks: European distributor stocking is mistaken for durable patient/physician sell-through.
A competing PN or other biostimulator product reduces REJURAN pricing power and procedure share.
The U.S. FDA classifies the medical REJURAN pathway less favorably than management expects, delaying entry and increasing trial/CMC cost.
Patent expiry or design-around risk after 2028 reduces exclusivity faster than brand/clinical network can compensate.
CG USA integration and Plant 5 produce low utilization or low incremental returns.
H1 cash conversion weakness persists as receivables, inventory and channel working capital grow faster than sales.
The REJURAN Cosmetics halo proves more fashion-sensitive than the medical franchise.
RCPS conversion or redemption transfers more value to the preferred holder than Base assumptions anticipate.
Management again pursues a structure perceived as minority-shareholder unfriendly.
A safety or regulatory event hits the REJURAN master brand and simultaneously affects multiple product categories.
red_team.independence: Same analyst/model adversarial review; not independent committee approval.

completion_gate.scope: Research composition and audit lineage complete; unresolved facts and veto investigations are NOT marked resolved.

limits: Stored extracts and linked dated evidence are research assertions, not a new independent audit of every original filing.
Owner margins and Base values remain estimates; undisclosed reinvestment and rights items stay unresolved.

reverse_expectations.growth_basis: Year-1 revenue anchor fixed; uniform growth years 2-10 (milestone paths retain fixed capital costs).
reverse_expectations.warning: Conditional on Base margins, capital claims and terminal assumptions; not an observable unique market forecast.

review_method: Re-review all eight categories and nine vetoes using dated harness raw/evidence, reconcile latest/checkpoint differences, recompute cash scenarios and reverse expectations, refresh dated prices, retain unaffected judgments and document every score change. No macro-score mixing.
